newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss village to give away local Alp.
newsitem.headline: Swiss village to give away local Alp.

text.p: An isolated village in eastern Switzerland has decided to give away a local mountain as a stunt to drum up publicity for its new thermal baths, a local official said on Sunday.

A contest launched by civic leaders in Vals, a village of 900 inhabitants known previously only for its mineral water, offers the winner the honour of naming the rocky peak, which stands nearly 3,000 metres (9,000 feet) high.
Pius Truffer, chairman of the new thermal baths, said anyone could enter the contest for free.
He confirmed a report in the SonntagsBlick newspaper that the winner's name would be registered with federal topographical authorities and entered in the local land register.
